paragraphs.text:
Although  startled,  the  blade-wielder  has  the  presence  of 
mind to complete his deadly work before running. Before the 
doomed boy understands what is happening, the sickle flashes 
and Bernard’s head drops free.

Make a Sanity roll for each remaining party member. If you fail 
yours, lose 1D6 Sanity. If both students succeed in their rolls, go to 
246. If both students fail, go to 118. If Norman fails his, go to 66. If 
Sylvia misses hers, go to 241.
